notes.title: Early Access Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.2 is now live!

New Features

Players can now select Extra Life as an option on all planets if they do not want to play with more than one creature 🦑

Added the wound module (this replaces the true damage module)

Private Galaxies now delete default creatures if more than 3 player-made creatures have been added to a depth 🦑

Credits have been added to the start menu

Added an option to show extended information during combat

Added an option to make the unspent DNA points warning less strict 🦑

Added a hotkey section to options

Best results now turn golden if you managed to reach depth 25 or beyond

Tasks now turn golden if you finished them 50 times


Progression Changes
Increased the research points that you get for reaching research stations to 2, 4, 4, 5 (previously 1, 2, 2, 5)

Balance Changes
The True Damage Module has been replaced by the Wound Module

Tridacna heals to 25% health when it closes (down from 50%)

Increase creature health modifier gives +4 health (up from +3)

Speed scaling has been reduced by around 10% (60 to 55)

Robot base speed has been increased to 4 (up from 3)

Strong Core gives +3 health (up from 2)

Charged Core gives +3 health (up from 2)

Wind Up Core gives +2 health (up from 0)

Venom Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Juggler Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Swift Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Larval Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Anchor Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Nourished Core gives +3 health (up from 2)

Pacifist Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Proximity Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Companion Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Chaotic Energy Core gives +2 health (up from 0)

Hybrid Core gives +4 health (up from 3)

Dwarf Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Spiral Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Sensei Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Fast Forward Core gives +3 health (up from 2)

Doom Clock Core gives +5 health (up from 2)

Deadly Core gives +3 health (up from 2)

Bounty Hunter Core gives +3 health (up from 2)

Tinkerer Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Lightning Core gives +2 health (up from 0)

Mutagen Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Repeater Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Witch Core gives +4 health (up from 0)

Time Bomb Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Remedy Core gives +3 health (up from 2)

Purity Core gives +0 health (down from 2)

Matryoshka Core gives +5 health (up from 4)

Abomination size scaling has been reduced


The goal with most of these balance changes was to slow down the pace of combat to allow players to see more of their builds, since builds that try to kill the enemy as fast as possible (especially with true damage) seemed to start to dominate the meta. Overall I think it is healthier for the game if fights take a little bit longer.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where nullify would delete actions with the energized module even if they had a shield stack 🦑

Fixed a bug where a creature would only throw boomerangs downwards if it had the artillery core 🦑
Hotfix 1 (13.09.2025)
Fixed a bug where undo would turn extra life back into a creature on planet 3 and 4 🦑

Fixed true damage being affected by pacifist when it damages an action 🦑

Fixed resurrection not properly updating the stat UI

Improved menu texts



🦑: community suggestions or bug reports

Have fun playing :)

notes.title: Early Access Patch 1.0.1

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.1.0 German Localization!
notes.notes:
Demo Patch 1.1.0 is now live!

New Features:
Added german localisation to the game!

Improved and streamlined most descriptions to make it clearer how certain things interact. These have also led to some small balance changes.

Added a new audio system that handles multiple sounds playing at once better.

Added a new sound for the Doom Clock core.

Added new sounds for the Pinball core. 

Balance Changes:
Tridacna: Is no longer immune to true damage while closed.

Doom Clock: Effect changed to: At the end of its last state, a creature takes 1 true damage for each time it has gone through its state machine. This applies to both creatures.

Tentacle: Can no longer be weakened or poisoned.

Spiral Core: Bubble speed increase is now 5 (up from 3)

Pinball Core: Only adds one Dash to the inventory (down from 2)
Bug Fixes:
Pinball core effect is no longer active after a creature has died.

Fixed surrendering not working correctly with Tridacna.

Fixed window mode not working properly in some cases.


As always have fun playing and I'm always happy to get your feedback and suggestions :)

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.9 Patchnotes
notes.notes:
Demo Patch 1.0.9 is now live! 
New Features: Six new cores have been added: 
Deadly: All of your actions have +2 damage,

Fast Forward: All of your actions have +1 speed,

Doom Clock: Both creatures lose 2 health after their last state,

Pinball: Dash actions do not stop on collision and the creature bounces instead. Whenever the creature bounces while dashing it gets +1 strength and +1 speed,

Bounty Hunter: Whenever one of your actions combos, your creature spawns an additional copy of it,

Tinkerer: Your actions with the ALIVE tag have a 10% chance to spawn a copy of every action with the FRAGILE tag that your creature uses,
 The following cores have been moved to planet 2: 
Anchor,

Chaotic Energy,

Short action descriptions have been added to small action tooltips. Creature descriptions have been updated. Other small UI, description and visual improvements

Balance Changes: 
Tridacna: Only heals to half health when it closes,

Hexapus: Base speed increased to 4 (from 3),

Venom Core: Increases tick rate of poison instead of doubling it,

Generator Core: No longer gives health (down from 2). Only gives 4 shield stacks (down from 5). Adds a shield to your inventory,

Cleanse removes 20 stacks of negative effects (down from 25),
 Bug Fixes: 
Fixed a bug in steam initialization that prevented some players from joining online mode,

Venom now also increases the tick rate on enemy living actions,

Poison now also applies to dolphins,

 ---------------
This is the last major content update for the demo and I will focus on the early access release from here on. I will try to apply any small Quality of Life changes to the demo as well whenever possible. The Demo will be playable until Early Access releases.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.8 Patchnotes
notes.notes:
Demo Patch 1.0.8 is now live! 
New Features: 
Three new item rewards have been added: 

Cloning Device: Can be used on a shop option to add a copy of it to your inventory. The copy still costs DNA points,

Probability Amplifier: Can be used on a shop option to increase the chances of it appearing,

Suppressor: Can be used on a shop option to prevent it from appearing in the shop,

 The following cores now add shop options to your inventory when you pick them: 

Venom: Adds one poison module,

Juggler: Adds two bounce modules,

Tribal: Adds two boomerangs,

Polymelia: Adds one tentacle,

Larval: Adds one infested module,

Proximity: Adds two surprise modules,

Spiral: Adds two bubbles,

 Other new stuff: 

The font for the game has been updated,

Boomerang can now use the bounce module,

Increased the amount of rewards that the elite challenge gives,

Creatures with 50 or more unspent DNA will no longer be saved at the end of a run in online mode,

The game now checks if the client is up to date,

Fixed some typos,

Small UI improvements,
 Balance Changes: 
Distance scaling of bubbles with negative size has been increased,
 Bug Fixes: 
Fixed a bug where creature names did not get saved,

Fixed damage overflowing with the juggler core,

Fixed the game freezing if a trident had too much damage,

Fixed tadpole not getting a damage increase from juggler if a creature also had the larval core,

 ---------------

Have fun playing and let me know what you think of the new changes :)

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Demo Patch 1.0.1 Patchnotes:

I just released a small patch, that fixes some bugs and reported issues in the demo. 

General improvements:

Unlock cost for planets and creatures have been decreased.
The game now more frequently checks, whether a new depth has been reached by another player. This will decrease the chance of a player getting an end reached message even thought an other player already reached that depth during this run.
Username selection now starts with the input in focus and the name already selected
Random team button is disabled, if a player only has one creature type to select from.


Bugfixes:

Fixed a bug were dash would behave weirdly if it was followed by another dash at exactly the same time when the dash ended.
Fixed a bug where a run would not count as finished, if the player returns to the main menu during the run overview screen.


I am also currently reworking the unlock system, as that is confusing a lot of players. Hopefully I can also release that later today.

notes.title: Evolve Lab Demo Release Date and Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm thrilled to announce that the Evolve Lab Demo will officially launch this Friday, May 30st at 20:00 CET! 

This marks a big milestone, and I’m incredibly excited to share this with all of you who’ve supported the project so far. The demo will also be part of Steam Next Fest, which kicks off on June 9th. This gives me one more week to refine the demo and I'm counting on your feedback and suggestions to have a great version ready for everyone who will experience Evolve Lab for the first time during it.

If you’ve checked out the store page recently, you may have noticed the stunning new visuals! Huge thanks to RedPotionStudios for creating the gorgeous promotional art!

Whats changing with the demo release?

The closed alpha phase will end once the demo goes live. Alpha keys will no longer be valid.
Progress will be fully reset when switching to the demo.
From this point forward, demo progress will carry over to the full release!
You can still expect planets to be reset occasionally to keep the meta fresh.


Future Announcements:
Moving forward, most official updates like patch notes and news will be posted here on Steam. On the Discord server, I will keep it more personal and try to interact with you guys as much as possible. My dream would be to create a close community of people that love playing this game. So feel free to join the community, if you haven't already: Discord server.

Thank You
To everyone who’s played the game, shared feedback, and been part of this journey so far, thank you! Your input has been a huge part of shaping what Evolve Lab has become and I can’t wait to see what you think of the demo and how the game evolves from here on.
